competency_fulfillment.rationale: The competency pairs two verbs, 'describe and draw'; every sample tests only the describing half (counting directions in seed 42, naming the movement type in seed 44), and none of the 5 rendered items requires or evidences the drawing action the competency also names.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: All 5 seeds refer only to a generic 'a shape' rather than naming any specific basic shape or figure (square, triangle, rectangle), so whether the tool exercises the 'basic shapes and figures' plural the competency states cannot be confirmed from this batch.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The longest sample, seed 44's 'A shape slides 5 spaces to the left and 2 spaces down. What type of movement is this?', is about 16 words across two clauses, comfortably inside grade 3 quarter 4 reading demand.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Only two frames repeat across the 5 seeds -- direction-counting (42, 43, 46) and movement-naming (44, 45) -- with no item varying distance magnitudes beyond '2/3' and '5/2' or requiring the pupil to plot coordinates.

competency_alignment.rationale: Seed 44's distractor set -- 'flip (reflection)', 'one-direction slide', 'turn (rotation)' against the key 'two-direction slide (translation)' -- correctly isolates the two-direction-slide concept from adjacent but distinct transformation types.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Content is discrete small counts (2 spaces right, 3 up, 5 left, 2 down) suited to a grid-based grade 3 translation exercise, not a continuous numeric magnitude, so no scale-ceiling concern applies.
